title.narrative: Rural Finance Sector Development Cluster Program (Subprogram 2)

description.narrative: The Program is the second of two subprograms under the Cluster Program. The objective of the Program is to improve the soundness, efficiency, and outreach of the Borrower's rural finance sector through policy, legal, regulatory and institutional reform.

description.narrative: Inclusive rural finance system that is more sound and efficient, and has wider outreach.

Credit outreach of Small Farmers Development Bank (SFDB) increases from 140,000 accounts in 2008 to 360,000 accounts (of which 60% are women) by the end of 2013. Progress/Status: (274,000, of which 172,000 or 63% are women, as of Apr 2013) Target likely to be achieved by 2014. Actual value:

Credit outreach of Agricultural Development Bank Limited (ADBL) increases from 200,000 accounts in January 2010 to 250,000 accounts (of which 20% are women) by 2012. Progress/Status: (205,000 as of Apr 2013) Inclusive of clients of wholesale lending. ADBL is to propose a loan of NRs400 million from the Government for onlending to rural and agricultural sector in 2012. Data Source: -Program reports -Program reviews (semiannual, annual and midterm) -Audit reports -ADB reports -ADB review missions -Program completion report -Program performance evaluation report -NRB reports -Reports of financial institutions -Parliamentary briefings -Reports of the government auditor general Actual value:
Pending cases at the Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT) reduced from 830 in 2008 to 530 by end 2012. Progress/Status: (166 as of Apr 2013) Actual value:
At least 60 cooperatives start providing microcredit in the hills and mountains by end 2011. Progress/Status: (94 as of Apr 2013) SFDB signed partnership agreement with 24 new RFIs (non-SFCLs)
National Banking Training Institute (NBTI) provides training to approximately 400 rural finance practitioners annually from 2010. Progress/Status: (5,414 as of Apr 2013) Progress more than target
